query: What information does the SMU Academic Calendar provide?
expected_answer: The academic calendar provides information about courses, programs, admission requirements, schedules, costs, regulations, and student support services. It also contains course descriptions and prerequisites.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-001. Tests whether retrieval captures core academic calendar functions including prerequisites, course descriptions, and programs.

query: How can I arrange a campus tour at Saint Mary's University?
expected_answer: Contact the Centre for New Students by calling 420-5682, emailing campustours@smu.ca, or submitting the online Campus Tour Request Form. Booking at least one week in advance is recommended.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-004. Tests retrieval of tour booking channels (phone 420-5682, email campustours@smu.ca, online form) and booking advance window.

query: What is Self-Service Banner used for?
expected_answer: Self-Service Banner allows students to register for courses, pay tuition, view grades and exam schedules, print T2202A forms, and access other university services. Faculty and staff can use it for relevant employment and academic tasks.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-005. Tests identification of Banner capabilities for both students (courses, grades, tuition) and staff/faculty.

query: Where can I get help with computer problems at SMU?
expected_answer: The ITSS Help Desk provides assistance with software and university computer problems. It has locations in the Atrium and Loyola Academic 268. The supplied FAQ lists phone number 496-8111 and email helpdesk@smu.ca.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-006. Tests retrieval of ITSS Help Desk locations (Atrium, LA 268) and contact channels (496-8111, helpdesk@smu.ca).

query: When does course registration usually begin?
expected_answer: Registration for each academic year (September - April) typically begins in April. Registration for spring and summer sessions typically begins in March. Students should check Registration Dates to find out when they are eligible to register.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-230 ('When can I register?'). Verified that dataset explicitly establishes April (academic year) and March (spring/summer) dates.

query: What does a course prerequisite mean?
expected_answer: A prerequisite is a course or requirement that must be satisfied before enrolling in another course. In SMU regulations, courses numbered 2000 and above usually have prerequisites outlined in the Academic Calendar.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-076 and SMU-FAQ-001. Evaluates whether the system retrieves prerequisite requirements for courses numbered 2000+ and relates them to calendar prerequisites.

query: Can I access the Student Health Clinic if I already have a family doctor?
expected_answer: Yes. Even if you already have a family doctor (physician), you are welcome to access the Student Health Clinic.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-197 ('Can I access he Student Health Clinic if I have a family physician?'). Confirms that students with outside physicians are eligible.

query: Does the Student Health Clinic provide dental services?
expected_answer: No, the Student Health Clinic does not provide dental services.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-204 ('Does the Student Health Clinic provide dental services?'). Tests explicit negative factual assertion.

query: Is counselling free for registered SMU students?
expected_answer: Yes, counselling services at The Counselling Centre are free for any currently registered student at Saint Mary's University.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-212 ('Is there a cost to attend counselling at The Counselling Centre?'). Verifies free service for registered students.

query: Can students have overnight guests in residence?
expected_answer: Normally yes, overnight guests are permitted for up to two consecutive nights, provided all roommates/suitemates consent and agree. Residents remain responsible for their guests' actions. Longer stays require permission from Housing & Residence.
evaluation_notes: Ground truth verified in SMU-FAQ-195 ('Can I have overnight guests in residence?'). Tests conditionality (consent of roommates, two consecutive night limit, student responsibility).
